scripts.script:
INT. BUS STOP - NIGHT
PRIYA shivers under the street lamp, checking her watch.
PRIYA
Last cab cancelled. It's past midnight.
A clean night bus pulls up and the doors hiss open.
BUS DRIVER
Station and hospital route running all night now. Step on in.
PRIYA (relieved)
First night route? You saved my shift.
scripts.notes: Drama format conveying the new night bus route connecting the station and hospital, with personal stakes.
